serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: W-what should I do?
Bot: Is there a problem?
You: Y-yeah, apparently we are getting kicked out…
Bot: From this room?
You: Yes.
Bot: Why?
You: I don’t have enough money…
Bot: …
You: D-don’t worry! He’s probably just bluffing! I will get the money tomorrow and give it to him!
Bot: If you say so. Mr Landlord is really good at bluffing. Even with my receptors I couldn't tell.
You: …
